observations.behavior: Replacement of local, error-prone post-run cleanup and warehouse registration with a shared, parameterized call. The removed code handled DeltaLake compaction, S3 file preparation, warehouse registration, CDC companion seeding, and analytics view syncing, while the added code delegates these responsibilities to an external shared implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: This change removes the warehouse ingestion pipeline's implementation of post-load operations and replaces it with a shared implementation, potentially improving consistency and maintainability across warehouse ingestion workflows.
